phasing_details.phase_detail: Entire Development - There are no works expected.

description:
This application is for a change of use for the property 318 Dagenham Heathway from C3 Dwelling House to C4 Houses in multiple occupation. This is a residential dwelling 1 storey. The ground level comprises of a lobby, lounge, kitchen diner, communal bathroom and separate WC. There are 3 bedrooms and a communal bathroom form part of the 1st floor. 
The property has selective licence that was issued on 14 May 2021, due to expire on 13 May 2026. It is a house rented to single household. This planning permission is to change to C4 Houses in multiple occupation – additional license for 4 unrelated individuals. This property already has approved planning permission for rear extension in January 2024. However no work has been carried out yet. For this application, there are no works are expected to be carried out on this property. 

The size of each room is defined as below:
-	First floor bedroom A: 9.9m2
-	First floor bedroom B: 13.4m
-	Frist floor bedroom C: 7.1m
-	Kitchen on ground floor: 9.3m. There is 1 oven with 4 hobs, 1 sink, 1 fridge freezers. There are worktops and cupboards.  
-	Communal space on ground floor: 14.4 
-	First floor shower room with toilet and wash hand basin: 4m
-	Ground floor bathroom with bath and shower, toilet and wash hand basin 
-	Separate WC with WHB

Fire precautions have already taken place in the property. A fire risk assessment was taken on 21st May 2025 by Fireflux Holdings Ltd. All recommendations by the assessor has been taken on board and rectified. 
-	All doors are Fire Doors FD30s. Each door has Intumescent strips with cold smoke seal with self-closers on the doors. 
-	There are fire blankets, fire extinguishers and fire alarm system in the property
-	There are emergency lightings in place
-	All bedrooms have thumb turn locks
-       there is also heating certificate for the heating system in the kitchen

All certification required for the house are completed. These include
-	Fire alarm test certificate
-	EICR
-	Gas safety certificate
decision_conditions: The proposed development would result in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. While it would provide a dwelling in the form of an HMO, it fails to demonstrate that this meets an identified need, and further would not provide an adequate quality of accommodation to support a high standard of living, and would cause a loss of local amenity including to neighbouring occupiers. The site is therefore not suitable for an HMO use. As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's housing supply and is contrary to the following policies: National Planning Policy Framework (December, 2024)Policies D6, D14 and T4 of the London Plan (March, 2021)Policies SP3, SP8, DMD1, DMT1, DMH5 and DMSI3 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September, 2024)

The proposed development would fail to provide sufficient internal amenity space with regard to the bedroom sizes. The development would therefore be detrimental to the living standards of future occupiers and would result in a poor quality of accommodation, contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development provides a high standard of amenity:DCLG Technical Housing Standards (nationally described space standard) (DCLG, March 2015) (as amended)Policy D6,  Policy H1 and H2 and Table 3.1 of the London Plan (March, 2021)Policies SP3, DMD1 and DMH5 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September, 2024)Housing Design Standards LPG (June 2023)East London HMO Guidance (4)

The proposed development would result in additional noise and disturbance to surrounding occupiers, to the detriment of neighbouring residential amenity. The proposal therefore comprises un-neighbourly development, contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development provides a high standard of amenity: Policies D6, D14 and GG3 of the London Plan (March, 2021) Policies DMD1, DMH5 and DMSI3 of the Local Plan (September, 2024)
